recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Treat FHIR-52018 and FHIR-51842 as separate decisions; FHIR-50314 needs no further source work unless OO later wants general editorial cleanup of the already-applied prose.
issue_request: FHIR-50314 was an Applied, Persuasive with Modification R6 OO ballot change request for the Nutrition module and related NutritionIntake/NutritionProduct topics. Its final resolution narrowed this issue to adding the attached newborn/infant human milk and formula use case description to the Nutrition module and split the value-set and BDP/NutritionProduct boundary items to FHIR-52018 and FHIR-51842.
initial_application: Upstream commit f08af008345a71485a7eee5f3ce559a3c12559dd, "Updates for issues FHIR-31545, FHIR-50383, FHIR-52017, FHIR-50314", added Human Milk, Formula, and Human Breast Milk and Infant Formula use cases to source/nutrition-module.html.
additional_context: source/nutrition-module.html is in build scope through source/hierarchy.xml, and NutritionIntake, NutritionOrder, and NutritionProduct are active in source/fhir.ini. OO Nutrition minutes show the work group developing the infant feeding cases in June/July 2025 and voting FHIR-50314 Persuasive with Modification on 2025-08-27. FHIR-52018 and FHIR-51842 cover the split-off value-set and boundary topics.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Nutrition module source already includes the requested infant feeding use-case descriptions with the relevant NutritionOrder, NutritionIntake, NutritionProduct, and Observation references.

related_jiras.note: Split from FHIR-50314 for the NutritionIntake nutritionProduct binding/value-set-description request and resolved as no change because human milk was already in the expanded value set.
Split from FHIR-50314 for BiologicallyDerivedProduct/NutritionProduct boundary text and handled as a separate Applied issue.
